'''Pordi zet Chatc''' was a [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] playwright during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He wrote the tragedy [[Torphceris (play)|''Torphceris'']] which was named after the last [[Argazdan Regent]] [[Torphceris]]. It described his role in the construction of the [[Slave Pits of Lorrd]] through the use of Lorrdian slave labor towards the end of the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]].
